in_marathi.name: Megharaj
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God of Clouds, Rain
in_marathi.long_meaning: Megharaj हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Megha (cloud) + Raja (king). The name Megharaj is derived from the Sanskrit language, and it refers to the king of the clouds and the bringer of rain. In Hindu mythology, Megharaj is considered a divine deity associated with the monsoon season, fertility, and abundance.
